statement: The T0 targetedTests check fails because run-tests.sh runs `grep -q correct src/impl.txt`, but src/impl.txt currently contains only the literal text 'wrong' (no occurrence of the substring 'correct'), so grep exits 1 and the gate reports targetedTests pass:false with exit 1 and empty outputTail. This is unrelated to the actual auth registration/login/logout/session-management golden fixtures (p-5..p-8), which appear well-formed and are not themselves being exercised by run-tests.sh in this fixture setup.
